# wasm3

The WebAssembly interpreter that hosts engines (DESIGN 5.11) in C and C++
applications generated by Clarity: the core of [wasm3](https://github.com/wasm3/wasm3)
v0.5.0, `source/*.c` and `source/*.h` as released, MIT (see LICENSE). Left
out: its WASI, libc and tracer bindings (`m3_api_*`) and extensions, since an
engine imports nothing. A generated application gets these files only when it
declares an engine.

One change, marked `Clarity:` in `m3_compile.c`: `call_indirect` reads its
table index as a full LEB number, as compilers with reference types (Rust
since 1.82, recent clang) write it, instead of one byte.
